# langsmith_mcp_vendor (Data Source)

Looks up an MCP vendor by `vendor_slug`. MCP vendors are read-only platform-level registrations (no resource counterpart).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_mcp_vendor" "github" {
  vendor_slug = "github"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vendor_slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `icon` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `provider_id` (String)
- `settings_json` (String) JSON-encoded vendor-specific settings.
- `status` (String) `enabled` or `disabled`.
- `vendor_id` (String)
